name: Ecuador
headline: Ecuador: +3.7% growth in 2025, 0.7% inflation, debt 55% of GDP
sections: Ecuador is a $130 billion economy (2025), the world's 66th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +3.7% in 2025, close to the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $17K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 13.2% of GDP (2025).
Consumer prices rose 0.7% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 3.5% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 3.1% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 8.2% (2025).
Gross government debt is 55% of GDP (2025), a moderate level that has fallen from 64% in 2020. The general government balance is −2.8% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is +5.9% of GDP (2025), a large surplus. Trade equals 59% of GDP (2025), a fairly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 1.0% of GDP (2025).
Life expectancy is 77.6 years (2024). Population: 18.1 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
